makemeahanzi.definition: to write; to draw, to sketch; to compose
to drill, to pierce; to dress, to wear

characterDeckComponents.note: 牙 (tooth) — teeth piercing or boring through something, the origin of 'to pierce'
穴 (xué) gives a sound distantly related to 穿's reading chuān, having drifted apart considerably over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to do; to mock, to tease; to play with

etymology.hint: Two hands 廾 playing with a piece of jade 玉; 廾 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 玉 (jade) pictures a treasured object.
廾 pictures two hands, together giving 弄 its meaning 'to play with, to handle, to do.'

makemeahanzi.definition: final particle of an assertion

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 啦 is a sentence-final particle, spoken from the mouth.
拉 (lā) is an exact match for the sound of 啦.

makemeahanzi.definition: still, but; decline; retreat

characterDeckComponents.note: 卩 (a kneeling figure, related to 'seal') — ties to 却's older sense of a person stepping back or retreating.
去 (qù) gives the sound — 却 is pronounced què, a close match sharing the same initial and a similar vowel.

makemeahanzi.definition: to calculate, to count; to figure, to plan

characterDeckComponents.note: ⺮ (bamboo) — the material of ancient counting rods.
具 (held in two hands) — bamboo counting rods or an abacus held up for use, the tools of calculation that gave 算 its meaning 'to calculate, count.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to see off, to send off, to dispatch; to give

etymology.hint: A person waving 关 to someone walking away 辶

characterDeckComponents.note: 关 — a person's arms shown in a waving or embracing gesture, bidding farewell
辶 (to walk) — the person walking away who is being seen off

makemeahanzi.definition: according to; so as to; because of; then
to play with, to joke, to entertain

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (jade, written without its dot) — 玩 originally meant to handle and admire a piece of jade, extending to 'to play, to have fun.'
元 (yuán) gives a sound distantly related to wán, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to accomplish; to become; to complete, to finish; to succeed
clause, condition; string, stripe
enough, adequate; to reach, to attain; to pass muster

characterDeckComponents.note: 多 (more/many) — 够 relates to having a sufficient amount
句 (jù) gives a loose sound connection to 够's reading gòu

makemeahanzi.definition: to run, to flee, to escape

characterDeckComponents.note: 足 (foot) — 跑 describes an action done with the feet, running.
包 (bāo) gives a sound close to pǎo, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: moon; month

characterDeckComponents.note: 月 is a simple picture of a crescent moon.

makemeahanzi.definition: early; soon; morning

etymology.hint: The first rays 十 of the sun 日

characterDeckComponents.note: 日 (sun) — represents the sun.
十 depicts the first rays of sunlight appearing low on the horizon — together with 日 (sun) giving 早 its meaning 'early, morning.'

makemeahanzi.definition: long, lasting; to excel in

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 長; an old man with long hair and a cane

characterDeckComponents.note: 长 (simplified from 長) depicts an elderly figure with long flowing hair and a cane — length and seniority are linked in the original picture.

makemeahanzi.definition: mark, sign; symbol; number; to call, to cry, to roar

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 号 relates to calling or crying out aloud, as well as a spoken or marked sign
丂 gives a loose sound connection to 号's reading hào

meanings: thing with shape or function similar to a gun

makemeahanzi.definition: gun, rife; lance, spear

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (wood) — early spears and rifle stocks were made of wood.
仓 (cāng) gives a sound close to qiāng, sharing the same rhyme.

makemeahanzi.definition: dog

characterDeckComponents.note: 犭 (dog/animal) — 狗 names an animal, the dog.
句 (jù) gives a sound distantly related to gǒu, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to talk, to chat; conversation; surname

characterDeckComponents.note: 讠 (speech) — 谈 relates to talking, conversation
炎 (yán) gives a sound close to 谈's reading tán

makemeahanzi.definition: head; chief, boss; first, top

characterDeckComponents.note: 大 (big) — in 头's simplified form, this element is linked to the idea of 'high' or topmost, since the head sits at the top of the body.

makemeahanzi.definition: year; years old, age; harvest
to exist, to live, to survive; living, working

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 活 relates to water flowing, a symbol of life and vitality.
舌 (shé) gives a hint of the sound — 活 is pronounced huó, a connection that has shifted over time.

meanings: (after a verb or adjective) one who (is) ...
(old) (used at the end of a command)

makemeahanzi.definition: that which; they who; those who
interjection used to call attention

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — both greeting someone and feeding a baby involve the mouth.
畏 (wèi) gives the sound — an exact match for 喂.

makemeahanzi.definition: to complete, to finish, to settle; whole

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (roof/house) — relates to 完's meaning 'complete, finish,' as in a fully built house.
元 (yuán) was the phonetic base; the pronunciation later shifted to wán, so only a partial rhyme remains today.

makemeahanzi.definition: to display; to expand, to open; to stretch; a sheet of paper

characterDeckComponents.note: 弓 (bow) — relates to 张's original meaning 'to draw a bow taut,' extended to 'to open, stretch.'
长 (cháng) gives a sound hint — 张 is pronounced zhāng, sharing the same rhyme though the initial consonant and tone differ.

makemeahanzi.definition: to connect, to join; to receive, to meet, to answer the phone

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 接 relates to receiving or connecting something by hand.
妾 (qiè) gives a hint of the sound — 接 is pronounced jiē, a connection that has shifted over time.

meanings: classifier for events and happenings: spell, episode, bout

makemeahanzi.definition: field, open space; market, square; stage

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 场 relates to a flat open area of ground, such as a field or venue.
昜 (yáng) gives a hint of the sound — 场 is pronounced chǎng, a connection that has drifted significantly over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to seek; to request, to demand; to beseech, to beg for
hard, strong, tough; just, barely

characterDeckComponents.note: 刂 (a knife, related to 刀) — ties to 刚's meaning 'firm, hard, strong'
冈 (gāng) gives the sound — 刚 is also pronounced gāng, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: particle used to express surprise

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 呀, a spoken particle, comes from the mouth.
牙 (yá) gives the sound — an exact match with 呀.

makemeahanzi.definition: to change, to transform, to alter; rebel
root, origin, source; basis

etymology.hint: A tree 木 with its roots highlighted

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — provides the base image of a tree.
一 (a line) marks the base of the trunk, highlighting the roots — giving 本 its meaning 'root, origin, source.'

makemeahanzi.definition: hard, difficult, arduous; unable

etymology.hint: A hand 又 trying to grasp at a bird 隹

characterDeckComponents.note: 又 (a hand) — reaching out to try to catch something.
隹 (a bird) — catching a bird by hand is hard, giving 难 its meaning 'difficult.'

makemeahanzi.definition: each, every

characterDeckComponents.note: 母 (mǔ, 'mother') serves as the phonetic base; the sound has since diverged from měi, so the connection is mostly historical today.

makemeahanzi.definition: job, part, role; duty

etymology.hint: The lot or portion 分 allotted to a man 亻

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — the person receiving a share
分 (to divide) — the portion allotted to that person

meanings: branch of a company or organization

makemeahanzi.definition: stand, station; to halt, to stand; website; measure word for stands and stations

characterDeckComponents.note: 立 (to stand) — 站 relates to standing, and by extension a stop or station where one stands to wait
占 (zhàn) gives the sound — 站 is also pronounced zhàn, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to vomit; an infant's cry

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 哇 is a sound made with the mouth, an interjection.
圭 (guī) gives a sound only distantly related to wa today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: name; position, rank, title

etymology.hint: A name called out 口 to hail someone at night 夕

characterDeckComponents.note: 夕 (evening, night) — in the dark, one could not see a person's face, so calling out their name was necessary to identify them.
口 (mouth) — calling out with the mouth at night gave 名 its meaning 'name.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to gather, to collect; overall, altogether

etymology.hint: Many mouths 口 speaking with one mind 心

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouths) — 总 pictures many voices.
心 (heart, mind) — many mouths brought together under one mind gave 总 its meaning 'overall' or 'to gather together.'

meanings: classifier for pieces of cloth, cake, soap etc
(coll.) classifier for money and currency units

makemeahanzi.definition: piece, lump, chunk; dollar; measure word for currency

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth/soil) — 块 originally referred to a lump or clod of earth
夬 (guài) gives a sound distantly related to 块's reading kuài, having drifted apart over time

makemeahanzi.definition: to stay, to remain; to preserve, to keep; to leave a message;
Zhou dynasty; circumference

etymology.hint: Border 冂 around land 土 with a well 口

characterDeckComponents.note: 冂 depicts a boundary or border enclosing an area.
土 (earth/land) — the land enclosed within the border.
口 here depicts a well within that land — together giving 周 its early meaning of a bounded territory, and later 'circumference, week, the Zhou dynasty.'

makemeahanzi.definition: father, papa

characterDeckComponents.note: 父 (father) — 爸 names a father.
巴 (bā) gives a sound close to bà, sharing the same syllable body and differing only in tone.

meanings: two (colloquial equivalent of 兩個|两个)

makemeahanzi.definition: two, a pair, a couple

etymology.hint: A couple 寿; 寿 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) shows this word refers to people.
两 (two) shows the meaning directly – 俩 means 'the two of them' or 'a couple of people.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to suspend, to halt, to delay; suitable

characterDeckComponents.note: 亻 (person) — 停 relates to a person coming to a halt
亭 (tíng) gives the sound — an exact match with 停's reading tíng

makemeahanzi.definition: another; separate, other
heart; mind; soul

characterDeckComponents.note: 心 was originally a pictograph of the physical shape of a human heart, and came to represent the mind, feelings, and intention as well.

makemeahanzi.definition: flower, blossom; to spend (time or money)

etymology.hint: A flower 艹 in bloom 化; 化 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (plant) — the living thing in bloom.
化 (transformation) — the plant changing into blossom, the source of 花's meaning 'flower.'
